description: This file defines a data class 'NoteEntity' representing a note in a local database, along with extension functions to convert between 'NoteEntity' and the domain model 'Note'. It also includes annotations for Room persistence library for database operations.

classes.name: NoteEntity
classes.description: A Kotlin data class annotated for Room to represent a note's data in the local database with fields for id, title, content, timestamps, and flags for deletion and dirtiness.

methods.name: toDomain
methods.description: Converts a 'NoteEntity' instance to a 'Note' object from the domain layer.

methods.name: toEntity
methods.description: Converts a 'Note' object from the domain layer to a 'NoteEntity' suitable for database storage.

calls: NoteEntity(id, title, content, createdAt, updatedAt, deleted, dirty)
Note(id, title, content, createdAt, updatedAt, deleted, dirty)
